_help: Edit the values, save, and restart app.py. Anything you leave out uses the default. Values marked CHECK are guesses: replace them with yours.

cube._connection_help: CHECK. A serial port ('COM8' on Windows, '/dev/ttyACM0' on Linux) or a network address like 'udpin:0.0.0.0:14550'.

joystick._disarm_help: true = while no joystick is plugged in the vehicle is kept disarmed (safety). Set false only for bench tests without a joystick.

web._host_help: 0.0.0.0 = other computers on the network can open the dashboard too. 127.0.0.1 = only this computer.

jetson._login_help: CHECK all five. Use a password OR a key_file (path to your private key). Leave the other one empty.
jetson._cmd_help: CHECK. start_cmd must return at once (the nohup ... & part keeps the script alive if the SSH link drops). check_cmd must exit with 0 when the script is running.
jetson.temps_cmd: for z in /sys/devices/virtual/thermal/thermal_zone*; do echo "$(cat $z/type) $(cat $z/temp)"; done
jetson._temps_help: Prints lines like 'CPU-therm 41500' (millidegrees). The line with CPU gives the CPU temperature, the line with GPU gives the GPU temperature. Empty string = do not read temperatures.
